notes: Same text as the 2023 twin GR-8.4.3.1.4-1 (CONFORMS). The communication SEND (§2002:A.2.6) was the one identifier position whose operand rules took no inline method invocation (FROM) and no function-identifier (WITH, ADVANCING); its three operands are now the one sendIdentifier rule (kb/Work PB5603). The golden applies an object-view before the inline invocation operator (`OU AS RQ5603C :: "GETY"`, `OB AS RQ5603I :: "GETI"`) in each SEND position.
